races.name: Heather Small Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Bradbury
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong finishing speed but severe hanging issues that have cost him recent wins when in front
runners_data.comment: Hung in front when second to Vietnorm at Ripon latest; 1lb better off here so big shout
runners_data.spotlight: Much improved for handicaps but has thrown away his last two as he looked sure to win before hanging violently in the closing stages (1m2f); still went close on both occasions and the new eyeshield could be a significant addition.

runners_data.name: Heart Sign
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning to hood after 39-day break, hasn't progressed in handicaps since promising maiden third
runners_data.spotlight: Not beaten far in a 7f AW maiden but hasn't kicked on at all in handicaps (1m-1m2f); ran okay on second run when once tried in a hood and that aid returns combined with blinkers.

runners_data.name: Captain Cairney
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 196-day layoff, showed best form in all-weather handicaps and recently gelded for potential improvement
runners_data.comment: Most exposed of these after seven runs but first and second in 1m2f Chelmsford nurseries
runners_data.spotlight: Had eight runs at two, showing best form when first and second in 1m2f handicaps at Chelmsford; bit to prove on turf but might progress further after being gelded.

runners_data.name: Gwen's Girl
runners_data.note: Sole prominent runner who can control the pace, returns to cheekpieces with step up to 1m2f potentially suiting better
runners_data.comment: Has struggled in the last three of her four runs including a 1m handicap last month
runners_data.spotlight: Easily her best run was when second on debut (6f, soft) and has finished well behind in her two handicaps (1m); the cheekpieces need to make a difference.

runners_data.name: Adores
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with concerning tendency to fade in the finish, disappointed last time but has shown some ability
runners_data.comment: Half-sister to three winners; worth a look but has stamina to prove on her turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: Disappointed at Windsor last time (1m3f) but her fourth on handicap debut (1m AW) has worked out fine and perhaps 1m2f will suit.

runners_data.name: Sahm Naif
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making handicap debut after being gelded, but badly beaten in all three qualifying runs
runners_data.comment: Big prices and soundly beaten in 7f and 1m events as 2yo; best watched for new yard
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 12l and 18l in his qualifying races (7f/1m), the latest on stable debut after being gelded; may show more in handicaps but hard to be confident.

runners_data.name: Too Darn Spicy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has never got closer than 8 lengths in five career starts, hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: May still be capable of a bigger effort at this sort of level
runners_data.spotlight: 0-5 and no closer than 8l, with that best run coming on her debut; beaten about 10l and 12l in two handicaps, over 7f on good to firm and 1m on soft.

races.paceDynamic: Gwen's Girl is the only confirmed front runner in this small field, giving her complete control of the tempo without early pressure. With six hold-up horses behind her, she can dictate a steady gallop that should see her still travelling well turning for home. The lack of pace pressure means the race will develop into a sprint finish where positioning and timing become crucial. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and hold-up horses with a strong finishing kick, as the gentle early gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Gwen's Girl gets an easy lead and stays the trip effectively
scenarios.body: Her soft early pace leaves her with energy reserves while the hold-up brigade face a wall of horses in the home straight. The cheekpieces and step up in trip could unlock improvement that sees her maintain her advantage to the line.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the gentle pace sets up perfectly for closers with tactical speed
scenarios.body: Bradbury's finishing kick proves decisive despite his hanging tendencies, while the field comes home in a bunch after crawling early. Hold-up horses with pace to burn get first run on the leaders and prove too strong.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Gwen's Girl stops suddenly and creates a messy finish
scenarios.body: The leader's lack of stamina at 1m2f sees her fade badly in the final furlong, bunching the field together. Captain Cairney's all-weather form translates as he finds a clear run through the pack.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Gwen's Girl shows genuine stamina improvement and kicks clear late
scenarios.body: Her controlled early fractions allow her to quicken again approaching the final furlong while others struggle to respond. The combination of trip and headgear change produces a career-best performance that leaves the field trailing.

watchPoints.text: Gwen's Girl getting an uncontested lead could prove decisive if the cheekpieces spark improvement
Bradbury's hanging tendency when in front - if he gets first run he may throw it away again in the final 100 yards
Captain Cairney's fitness after 196 days off the track, though being gelded suggests connections expect improvement
The pace early on - if Gwen's Girl goes too slowly it sets up a cavalry charge that could catch her out
Heart Sign's response to the hood returning after it helped on her previous outing in this headgear

races.name: Go West Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (GBB/IRE) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Mrs Mole
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 12,000gns yearling; second foal; dam Listed-placed 7f AW winner (RPR 98), half-sister to 1m6f winner Tristram, out of maiden half-sister to 2m Listed winner King Of Wands; first 2yo runner for the yard this season and she's probably best watched.

runners_data.name: See Amna
runners_data.spotlight: Fifth foal; sister to French 7.5f winner Zelkova, half-sister to Italian 7.5f-1m1f winner Alroucha; dam French 1m1f/9.5f winner (including Group 3; RPR 105), out of 1m2f winning half-sister to useful 1m-1m4f winner Stepping Ahead; yard 19% with 2yos this season and she's an interesting newcomer in this ordinary race.

runners_data.name: Wells Fargos Envoy
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 6f-1m4f winner (including 2yo; RPR 97), half-sister to 7.5f/1m winner Bob, out of maiden half-sister to 5f-7f winner Crystal Moments; one of two runners for yard and market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Better Nature
runners_data.comment: Already gelded and this looks a tough starting point
runners_data.spotlight: Never involved when 20-1 on Windsor debut (6f, good) last month but that was behind a useful prospect and he was only beaten around 5l; wasn't far behind Kach Above in that race and he's a possible improver upped in trip on his second start.

runners_data.name: Kach Above
runners_data.comment: Shaped with promise on Wolverhampton debut last week but that was an ordinary race
runners_data.spotlight: Well-bred colt who made a promising start when fourth at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month; only seventh of 12 at Windsor last time but he wasn't beaten far and that was a step forward from his initial effort; sets the standard on that form and he's open to more progress on this step up in trip.

runners_data.name: Parioca
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000gns daughter of Cotai Glory; beaten less than 3l when fifth of six at Southwell (7f; cheekpieces applied) last month but she didn't achieve much in that weak race; blinkers are now tried and she needs a major step forward on this switch to turf.

runners_data.name: Waiting For Archie
runners_data.comment: Lope Y Fernandez half-brother to 6f winner Maynora (RPR 58); market instructive
runners_data.spotlight: Well-held fifth of eight at Thirsk (5f, good to firm) last month, recording an RPR of only 43; this step up in trip could suit on pedigree but he needs major improvement on his second start.

runners_data.name: Lord Ragnar
runners_data.comment: 11,000euros yearling whose dam won over middle distances; may want more of a test
runners_data.spotlight: 11,000euros yearling whose dam won over 12.6f; didn't show much when 33-1 at Windsor (6f, good to firm) last month and he's probably a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Farndale
runners_data.comment: Newcomer; will probably need longer trips to be seen to best effect
runners_data.spotlight: 50-1 and was always behind when sixth of seven on Redcar debut (7f, good) three weeks ago; out of a middle-distance winner and she's probably one for longer trips later on.

runners_data.name: Pertinent
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1 and finished a remote last of ten on her debut here (5f, good to firm) last month; this trip looks a better fit on pedigree but she needs a transformation on her second start.

races.name: Go West Live @LeicesterRaces Saturday 4th July Restricted Maiden Stakes (Band D) (GBB/IRE) (Div II)

runners_data.name: Hoosthat
runners_data.spotlight: Third foal; dam 1m4f AW winner (RPR 64), out of close relative of US 8.5f stakes winner Bobcat Greeley, is granddaughter of half-sister to US 1m4f Grade 1 winner Silver Supreme and to dam of Miesque; yard 3-50 with 2yos last season and he could be a longer-term prospect.

runners_data.name: Mojito Madness
runners_data.spotlight: April foal; 8,500euros yearling, resold 16,000gns yearling; brother to winners Swing Out Sister (5f 2yo; RPR 76) and Seahorse Syd (1m/1m2f including 2yo; 65), half-brother to four winners including Online Alexander (5f including 2yo; 105) and Bnedel (1m AW 2yo/10.4f; 87); dam 7f winner (70); plenty to like on paper and he needs watching in market on debut.

runners_data.name: She Is Mighty
runners_data.spotlight: Second foal; dam 1m2f winner (RPR 74), half-sister to winners Educate (smart 1m-10.4f), Hippolytus (1m2f) and Ban Shoof (9.4f-1m4f), out of 7.4f-1m4f winning half-sister to 6f/7f Group 1 winner Somnus; has a striking pedigree and she needs checking in market on debut.

runners_data.name: Tiora Time
runners_data.spotlight: 16,000gns yearling; fourth foal; half-sister to 6f AW winner Tantomile (RPR 55); dam 7f-1m3f winner (84), half-sister to winners Afta Party (1m Flat/2m1f hurdle) and Line House (7f including 2yo), out of half-sister to 1m6f Group 2 winner Franklins Gardens; has speed and stamina in pedigree and market should guide on debut.

runners_data.name: Celtic Charioteer
runners_data.spotlight: January foal; brother to UAE 9.5f dirt winner Withering (RPR 109); never involved after a slow start on Windsor debut (6f, good) last month but he made some late gains and was only beaten around 5l; should know more this time and he's a likely improver upped in trip.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Bay
runners_data.comment: Not beaten far when sixth of 12 at Chepstow and that form makes him a leading player
runners_data.spotlight: Made encouraging debut when sixth of 12 at Chepstow (6f, good to soft) last month and he built on that when a close third over C&D (good to firm) five days later; that was a small-field seller last time but he has leading claims on that form and yard is 19% with 2yos this season.

runners_data.name: Mottaret
runners_data.comment: First foal from a low-grade 1m4f winner; not the obvious type to make a winning debut
runners_data.spotlight: Has plenty of stamina on dam's side and made an encouraging debut when fourth of seven at Redcar (7f, good; 28-1) three weeks ago; that form puts him firmly in the picture and he should be more streetwise this time; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Tiger In The Tree
runners_data.spotlight: Dam once-raced (RPR 58) half-sister to a hurdle winner; didn't show much at a big price on Redcar debut (6f, good) last month and she's probably one for later on.

runners_data.name: Jazzy Blue
runners_data.comment: 20,000euros yearling; sister to 1m AW winner Persian Jewel; yard 3-9 with 2yos this year
runners_data.spotlight: Ran green and she finished a remote sixth of eight on Yarmouth debut (6f, good to soft; 18-1) last month; should benefit from that experience but she needs major improvement upped in trip.

runners_data.name: Allaboutthelunch
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival on his debut here (5f, good to firm) in April and was out the back again at another big price at Wolverhampton (6f, AW) last month.

races.name: Racing Again This Saturday Evening 13th June Restricted Novice Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Vichenza
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who showed promise on debut despite traffic problems and benefits most from the expected strong early pace.
runners_data.comment: Bred for the job, half-sister to Listed winner out of Listed winner; interesting newcomer
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to 6f/7f winner Zoum Zoum (including Listed; RPR 113); looked inexperienced and had some traffic issues on Salisbury debut (6f, good) last month but she kept on well to finish third of 12 behind the favourite; that form puts her firmly in the picture and she should know more this time; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Muchacho
runners_data.note: Complete unknown making debut for new connections with no recent form guide or clear running style indicators.
runners_data.spotlight: 12,000euros foal, £16,000 yearling, 11,000euros 2yo; third foal; closely related to 5f AW winner Love Rock (RPR 59), half-brother to 5.7f winner Plutonic (71); dam 5f 2yo winner (including Listed; 94), half-sister to useful 5f/6f winner Gordon Bennett; has plenty of speed in his pedigree but this looks a tough starting point.

runners_data.name: Heddon Street
runners_data.note: Proven course winner but returning from 238-day layoff which raises serious fitness concerns despite his front-running class.
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to nine winners; stablemate of Ballybunion and market should guide
runners_data.spotlight: 32,000euros half-brother to nine winners including My Lea (Italian 5f/6f including 2yo/Group 3; RPR 106) and Royal Lea (Italian 5.5f/6f including Listed; 94); 11-2 on Yarmouth debut (6f, good) last October and he came from off the pace to win in emphatic style; has been gelded since but he's strongly respected under a penalty on his return; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Jellystone Park
runners_data.note: Front-runner in good recent form who was desperately unlucky when beaten a nose last time and should be sharper than the favourite.
runners_data.comment: Good front-running second at Doncaster last month; now tongue tied; bold bid expected
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth on Lingfield debut in March (6f, AW) and he built on that when a front-running second at Doncaster (6f, good; beaten a nose) last month; needs to take another step forward here but it's still early days and he's in the mix with hood added; bolted before the start and withdrawn last Monday (5-2 at the time).

races.paceDynamic: Heddon Street and Jellystone Park will clash for the early lead, with both horses showing clear front-running tendencies in their recent form. Heddon Street won from the front last time at Leicester over this trip, while Jellystone Park led for most of the way when narrowly beaten at Doncaster. With only four runners and two confirmed pace-setters, this creates a genuine speed duel early that should set up a strong gallop throughout. This honest pace heavily favours the hold-up horses who can sit off the pace battle and deliver late kicks.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Heddon Street and Jellystone Park go too fast early in their lead battle
scenarios.body: The two front-runners burn each other out in the opening half-mile, leaving the race wide open for closers to sweep past in the final furlong. Vichenza's hold-up style becomes the winning move as she picks up the pieces from the back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Heddon Street Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Heddon Street can get first run on Jellystone Park and establish a clear lead
scenarios.body: The 2022 winner settles into a rhythm without being pressured and uses his proven course form to kick clear. His 238-day break becomes irrelevant as class tells over this familiar track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jellystone Park Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Jellystone Park can improve on his recent Doncaster near-miss and time his kick better
scenarios.body: The Jack Channon runner uses his fresher preparation to outlast Heddon Street in the final stages after sharing the early pace. His 23-day gap gives him a fitness edge over the long-absent favourite.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Vichenza Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace battle is particularly fierce and Vichenza gets a clean run from the back
scenarios.body: Edward Greatrex gets the perfect trip on the Ralph Beckett filly as she avoids the early speed duel entirely. Her debut promise translates into a devastating late finish that catches the tiring leaders.

watchPoints.text: Heddon Street may need this run badly after 238 days off despite his course-winning form from 2022
Jellystone Park and Heddon Street could go too fast early if both are determined to lead, setting up the closers
Vichenza needs a clear passage from her hold-up position as she showed inexperience and hit traffic issues on debut
Muchacho is a complete wildcard making his debut with no form clues or recent workout information available
The small four-runner field means less cover for Vichenza if she needs to switch course late in the race

races.name: DSK Environmental Handicap

runners_data.name: Nebbia
runners_data.note: Hold-up filly returning from 35-day break with strong Windsor form suggesting improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Promising seasonal/handicap debut at Windsor this month; still has time to do better
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced on handicap/seasonal debut at Windsor (6f, good to firm) but she wasn't beaten far into fifth and she shaped as though the run would bring her on; capable of better.

runners_data.name: Percy's Star
runners_data.note: Prominent runner well-in on handicap debut with cheekpieces added after disappointing last start
runners_data.comment: Beat all bar the market leader over C&D last time, despite still seeming green; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Finished last of the four at Windsor two weeks ago but he looks well-in for handicap debut on his previous second there (6f, good to firm), and cheekpieces are now added.

runners_data.name: Life After Love
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who transfers well from AW success and shaped encouragingly on turf debut
runners_data.comment: Made it 3-3 over Southwell's 5f last time; needs more again upped 4lb on her turf debut
runners_data.spotlight: All three wins at Southwell but seemed fine on turf debut when beaten a little over 2l at Lingfield (good); down 1lb; can run well.

runners_data.name: Love Alive
runners_data.note: Most exposed hold-up runner whose best form came on AW, appears outpaced at this level
runners_data.comment: 5f AW win in February for Martin Dunne; makes stable debut with yard having a cold spell
runners_data.spotlight: The most exposed of these after nine runs and the win came on the AW (5f; off 2lb higher); only sixth of eight on recent stable debut at Redcar.

runners_data.name: Enter Sandman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with strong AW form wearing tongue-tie and cheekpieces, needs to transfer improvement
runners_data.comment: Progressed on the AW this spring; needs to transfer the improvement to turf upped 4lb
runners_data.spotlight: Has done well on the AW since fitted with a tongue-tie and cheekpieces, coming away with the favourite last time; raised another 4lb so needs to transfer the improvement to turf.

runners_data.name: Bessie Wallis
runners_data.note: Prominent runner wearing hood for first time after disappointing recent efforts
runners_data.comment: Found a weak AW novice here last autumn; has to prove this mark within range
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak AW novice last season; no further improvement this term and behind Life After Love last time; the hood needs to bring her on.

runners_data.name: Davorge Nation
runners_data.note: Prominent two-year-old returning from 268-day layoff after wind operation with solid nursery form
runners_data.spotlight: First (5f, good) and a close third (6f, AW) in nurseries before a quiet run on good to soft at Musselburgh; returns on a competitive mark and after a wind operation; could feature.

runners_data.name: I'm Dan Dare
runners_data.note: Front-runner who won well last time at Catterick but faces stronger opposition in higher class
runners_data.comment: Ex-Adrian Nicholls; nose second two runs back (headgear tried); chance on stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 for Adrian Nicholls; was backed on recent stable debut at Catterick (5f, good to firm) and he was never headed in winning well; that was a Class 6 and he's gone up 8lb, so has more on his plate; still much respected.

races.paceDynamic: I'm Dan Dare will lead this sprint with Percy's Star, Bessie Wallis and Davorge Nation tracking in the early positions, creating a decent gallop over this flat 5f straight. The prominent runners will likely settle just behind the pace-setter, while the hold-up horses Nebbia, Life After Love, Love Alive and Enter Sandman will find themselves towards the rear. With only one confirmed front-runner and several prominent types, the pace should be genuine but not frantic. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as they'll get a good gallop to aim at without being pressured early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If I'm Dan Dare sets a true gallop without being harassed by the prominent runners
scenarios.body: The strong pace will set up perfectly for the closers who can unleash late kicks. Horses like Life After Love and Enter Sandman will benefit from the solid tempo and their ability to quicken late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent horses prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Percy's Star and Bessie Wallis can track the leader closely and kick before the closers get organized
scenarios.body: The prominent runners will be in the perfect position to strike first, getting first run on the field. Their tactical advantage of being closer to the pace will prove decisive in this short sprint.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: I'm Dan Dare wire-to-wire
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runner can dictate a moderate tempo and save enough for the finish
scenarios.body: Without serious early pressure, I'm Dan Dare can control the race from the front and hold on. His recent Catterick win showed he has the pace to sustain his effort when allowed to lead comfortably.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses messy finish
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent horses fail to apply pressure and the race becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would suit the most naturally speedy horses regardless of style. The tactical advantage would shift to horses with the best pure pace rather than those positioned tactically.

watchPoints.text: I'm Dan Dare must be allowed to dictate his own tempo early - if pressed by Percy's Star or Bessie Wallis his chance evaporates
Enter Sandman and Life After Love need to be handy enough turning for home as this flat 5f track offers limited time for comebacks
Davorge Nation's wind operation and long absence make his fitness a key factor despite previously strong nursery form
Percy's Star's cheekpieces are applied after a poor last run - his response to the headgear will be telling
The hold-up horses must hope for genuine early pace as a slowly-run race would expose their lack of natural speed

races.name: Hugh James Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Shark Two One
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent Leicester record but concerning recent Doncaster flop needs bouncing back
runners_data.comment: Shaped with promise on Leicester reappearance and he looks interesting back up in trip
runners_data.spotlight: All five wins have been on turf and latest was in this race last year; his form nosedived at Doncaster last month but he has a striking record at this track and is versatile ground-wise; big player if he can bounce back.

runners_data.name: Bungle Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with poor turf record but close second at Wolverhampton last week shows current form
runners_data.comment: All eight wins have come here, five over this trip; 1-1 at this level and much respected
runners_data.spotlight: All eight wins have been at Wolverhampton and he went close in a classified event there (7f) last Tuesday; record of 0-12 on turf but he has placed form in this sphere and he seems fairly versatile ground-wise; key player.

runners_data.name: Eulalia
runners_data.note: Hold-up type struggling for new stable despite decent winter form for previous connections
runners_data.comment: Lightly raced filly but she's been well held in most of her runs; hard to weigh up
runners_data.spotlight: Ended last season with a good third in a Kempton handicap (7f, AW) for Charlie Fellowes; looks interesting on that form but she's struggled in both runs for current yard and is now 0-7; blinkers added.

runners_data.name: Coverbridge
runners_data.note: Rearfield runner stepping back in trip after poor season, likely needs further than 7f
runners_data.comment: A 7f AW winner as 2yo; just minor handicap form since April 2025 for this yard
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win was in a Newcastle maiden (7f, AW) two years ago and he's been well held in his three runs season; this big drop back in trip could help but others are more convincing; cheekpieces reapplied.

runners_data.name: Kode Grey
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who faded badly last time but gets weight allowance and longer trip suits
runners_data.comment: Good pace when third on handicap debut at Ripon 12 days ago and he's on the shortlist
runners_data.spotlight: Improved form when a front-running third in Ripon handicap (6f, good) last month but she failed to back that up at Carlisle ten days ago; still lightly raced but she has bit to prove again back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Shes Got The Blues
runners_data.note: Prominent racer still seeking first win but consistent recent efforts suggest breakthrough possible
runners_data.comment: 13-race maiden who is the most exposed contender
runners_data.spotlight: 14-race maiden but she's reached the frame in three of her last four runs including when fourth of 14 in a Windsor handicap (1m, good to firm) last time; should get a decent pace on this drop back in trip and she should go well again.

runners_data.name: Tilsworth Max
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with winter all-weather win but hasn't fired since returning to turf
runners_data.comment: In good form on AW during the winter but he didn't shine back on turf last month
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of good efforts on AW during the winter, including a win at Lingfield (7f) in January; that form puts him in the picture but he hasn't threatened back on turf in last two runs and overall record is now 1-29.

runners_data.name: Demetris Mouflon
runners_data.note: Rearfield runner who was well held in blinkers last time, needs significant improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced filly but she's been well held in most of her runs including when a 12l fifth in Lingfield handicap (7f, good; blinkers added) last month; that was after eighth months off but she needs improvement on this drop into a classified event.

runners_data.name: Bridgefoot Rambler
runners_data.note: Prominent type returning from 49-day break with poor recent form figures
runners_data.comment: Has struggled at big prices in two runs on turf and the latest was on recent stable debut
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled at big prices in her three runs including in two starts over 1m (good/AW) this spring; now drops into a classified event but she needs a transformation with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Tickhill Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse trying 7f for first time but struggled over shorter trips this season
runners_data.comment: Half-brother to three winners but well beaten at big odds last month on first two starts
runners_data.spotlight: Half-brother to three winners but he's struggled at big odds in three runs (5f-7f) this spring; now drops into a classified event but he needs a transformation with cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Due Destiny
runners_data.note: Rearfield runner making stable debut with hood fitted, longer trip should help
runners_data.comment: Poor form for Archie Watson last year; hooded for stable/seasonal debut
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in four 2yo runs for Archie Watson and was a well-held fifth in Lingfield handicap (6f, AW; hood added) on stable debut in April; should benefit from that run but she needs a major step forward at this new trip.

runners_data.name: Squashy Berry
runners_data.note: Hold-up type fitted with blinkers after disappointing recent efforts, needs big improvement
runners_data.comment: Big prices and well beaten in two starts over 6f; likely one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Has struggled in his three runs this year and was beaten 20l in a Lingfield maiden (7f, good) last time; still early days but he needs blinkers to make a big difference on this drop into a classified event.

runners_data.name: Miss Helena
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with ear plugs and blinkers returning from 74-day absence, major outsider
runners_data.comment: Modest form in a variety of events and headgear to date; still fairly early days
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled in two bumpers last autumn and same story at massive prices in four Flat runs this year; equipment now returns but she has stacks to find on the figures and can only be watched.

races.paceDynamic: Kode Grey is the only confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the start, likely getting an uncontested lead in this 13-runner field. With most runners preferring to settle behind (Bungle Bay, Eulalia, Coverbridge, Tilsworth Max all hold-up types), the pace should be sustainable through the early stages. Shark Two One and Shes Got The Blues may track the leader prominently, but neither is aggressive enough to apply serious pressure. This tactical setup strongly favours horses that can travel kindly in midfield and produce a late kick, as the moderate early pace will leave plenty in reserve for the finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Kode Grey gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows the front-runner to save energy and find extra when challenged, while late closers struggle to make up the ground. Prominent trackers like Shark Two One benefit from the perfect stalking position.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Kick Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and multiple hold-up horses get clear runs
scenarios.body: The patient tactics pay dividends as several runners unleash finishing kicks simultaneously, with the best turn of foot winning. Bungle Bay's all-weather form and Tilsworth Max's winter victories suggest they retain ability.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Shark Two One or Shes Got The Blues get first run on the field
scenarios.body: The experienced campaigner times the move perfectly from the ideal position, stealing a march before the hold-up brigade can respond. Shark Two One's course record becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Kode Grey goes too slow and gets swamped by a wall of finishers
scenarios.body: The crawling pace turns the race into a sprint finish where any horse with a modicum of ability can get involved. Even the outsiders become dangerous in a cavalry charge.

watchPoints.text: Kode Grey could steal the race if allowed uncontested fractions and kicks clear before closers respond
Bungle Bay's turf record is poor (0-12) despite recent all-weather form suggesting he retains ability
Track specialist Shark Two One needs monitoring for market confidence after his Doncaster nosedive
Several runners stepping up or down in trip (Due Destiny, Tickhill Flyer, Coverbridge) make distance calculations tricky
Multiple headgear changes (Squashy Berry's blinkers, Miss Helena's equipment) suggest connections expect improvement

races.name: Mesothelioma UK Handicap (GBBplus Race)

runners_data.name: Seagolazo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on a reduced mark who showed ability at Windsor recently in similar conditions
runners_data.comment: 0-11 in handicaps and failed to improve for visor (retained) last time
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden winner who is 0-12 in handicaps but he's on a reduced mark and ran respectably in a Class 3 at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) two weeks ago; has possibilities if he can find something extra and he won't mind what the weather does.

runners_data.name: Noble Horizon
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer for top jockey De Sousa who won at this course and distance previously
runners_data.comment: Bought for 140,000gns after good 3rd of 19 (10.5f, good; not clear run) in October; player
runners_data.spotlight: Won a C&D novice (good to firm) for William Haggas last July and was third of 19 in a York handicap (10.3f, good) in his final run last season; well held on stable debut at Lingfield last month but he shaped as though he needed the run and that form has been well advertised by the first two since; dangerous if he can get back near best.

runners_data.name: Nowshesdancing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse having just third career start with potential improvement to come
runners_data.comment: Debut form (10.5f, AW) nothing special but she finished to cracking effect to grab a win
runners_data.spotlight: Made a winning debut in Dundalk maiden (10.6f, AW) for Mark Fahey in January; reappeared for new yard with a third at Wetherby (1m2f, good to firm) in April and that was a creditable effort behind a 4-9 shot; should have more to offer now switched to handicapping and she's in the mix.

runners_data.name: Zatsgood
runners_data.note: Front-runner making turf debut after AW success but style suggests he'll handle the switch
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-French gelding; all four runs have been on AW and he found more progress when landing the odds on handicap debut at Lingfield (1m) last month; up 4lb but he still looks on a workable mark and should be unfazed by this step up to 1m2f; strongly respected on turf debut.

runners_data.name: Tipsy Tiger
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 231 days absence and needs slower ground ideally
runners_data.spotlight: His last win was at Sandown (1m2f, soft) in September 2024 but he went close at Nottingham on his penultimate run last season; ideally suited by slow ground and could be dangerous if conditions are suitable on his return.

runners_data.name: The Green Mile
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won last time in hood and showed improved attitude
runners_data.comment: Two starts since 2024 but encouraging he's putting a couple of runs together; check market
runners_data.spotlight: Has mixed record in his six starts but he added to his debut win for the Crisfords when landing a Chepstow handicap (1m2f, good to soft; hood applied) last month; up 4lb but he beat a clear second last time and he still has potential; shortlisted.

runners_data.name: Percy's Daydream
runners_data.note: Front-runner who disappointed badly last time when odds-on favourite
runners_data.spotlight: Record of 3-9 on turf but she finished a remote last of four in her bid for a double at Catterick (1m4f, good) last month; has bit to prove again after that and it would be a worry if rain arrives (almost all of her runs have been on good/good to firm.)

runners_data.name: Ted Le Saux
runners_data.note: Lead/prominent horse from top yard but remains lightly raced and unexposed on turf
runners_data.comment: Down the field on his handicap debut in April; mark looks high enough
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Newcastle novice (1m, AW) in January but was down the field on handicap/turf debut at Haydock (10.4f, good to firm) in April; remains unexposed after only four starts but needs to resume his progress.

runners_data.name: Crystal Mariner
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who may have needed his reappearance run at Chepstow
runners_data.comment: Went back-to-back (1m3f, AW) before slowly run series final didn't work out; possibilities
runners_data.spotlight: Triple AW winner who completed a Kempton double (1m3f, AW) in October but he's been well held in two starts since; may have needed his reappearance run at Chepstow last month but that took his turf record to 1-13 and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Double Red
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who is unpredictable and was tailed off on turf return last time
runners_data.comment: Fourth win when scoring on return; up 5lb and this is tougher but he's progressive
runners_data.spotlight: Acts on good to firm and good to soft; reappeared with a comfortable AW win in April but he's not easy to predict and was tailed off back on turf at Lingfield (1m2f, good to firm) last month; needs to bounce back again after that but he still looks feasibly treated on his penultimate form.

runners_data.name: Woodstock City
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 149 days layoff with fitness question mark
runners_data.spotlight: Won a 1m3f Class 5 handicap at Southwell in October and slightly better form when collared late over 1m2f at Lingfield in January; broke out of stalls and withdrawn at Kempton 11 days later (10-1 at the time); now returns to turf after a break but he's a dual winner in this sphere and is versatile ground-wise; possibilities.

races.paceDynamic: Zatsgood, Percy's Daydream, and Ted Le Saux will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-testing trip. The three confirmed front-runners will set a searching pace that should expose any stamina limitations in this 11-runner handicap field. With genuine speed horses committed to making the running, the race will develop into a true test of staying power rather than a sprint finish. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina reserves who can pick up the pieces when the early leaders weaken.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners commit to the early lead and maintain a solid gallop
scenarios.body: The sustained pace will find out the leaders in the final two furlongs, setting up perfectly for the hold-up horses to make their challenge. Noble Horizon, The Green Mile and Crystal Mariner can all benefit from this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters manages their effort better and gets first run on tired rivals
scenarios.body: Zatsgood or Percy's Daydream could dictate terms and kick clear when the others are still getting organized in behind. The winner comes from those setting the pace rather than those trying to catch them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but not suicidal, allowing a handy horse to track and pounce
scenarios.body: Seagolazo and Woodstock City can sit close enough to the pace without doing the donkey work. They can then strike when the leaders start to tire but before the hold-up horses get into gear.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Moderate Pace Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back to the field dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where tactical positioning matters more than stamina. This would suit horses that can quicken rather than those that need a true test of stamina.

watchPoints.text: Zatsgood making his turf debut after four AW runs could struggle with the surface change despite his front-running style
Percy's Daydream finished last of four when favourite last time and needs to bounce back to form
The Green Mile wore a hood when winning last time and connections have kept the headgear on
Woodstock City has been off for 149 days and may need this run despite his capable yard
Noble Horizon gets the services of champion jockey De Sousa who rarely takes poor rides

races.name: Smooth FM Ladies' Day Saturday 4th July Book Now Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Antiphon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who acts well on this going but comes back from a 235-day break which raises fitness concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Acts on good to firm and soft; his last win was in April 2024 but he was much better than this level in his time and he ran several good races at Brighton (5.3f) last season; returns after 235 days off but he needs a close look for in-form yard.

runners_data.name: Dreambird Dolly
runners_data.note: Recent near-miss in new headgear suggests return to form, suits prominent style and returns quickly from 10-day break
runners_data.comment: 0-17, but placed in three of her five starts over C&D; new headgear combination
runners_data.spotlight: 0-18 but she bounced back with a near-miss in new headgear at Brighton (5.3f handicap) ten days ago; has leading claims if she can repeat that form and she seems fairly versatile ground-wise.

runners_data.name: Dunnington Lad
runners_data.note: Previous 5f winner at Ripon but poor recent form including 11-13 length defeats raises serious questions
runners_data.comment: Last year was a struggle and he reappeared with an 11l defeat at Redcar; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Won twice over 5f at Ripon in 2024 but last year was a struggle and he's been beaten 11l and 13l in his two runs this season; has lots to prove and he needs a major revival with tongue-tie reapplied.

runners_data.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces challenge over minimum trip despite recent AW success and 7lb weight advantage
runners_data.comment: Been found the right race and holds obvious claims on his last-time 6f win here in March
runners_data.spotlight: Off the mark at the eighth attempt when justifying favouritism in a Wolverhampton handicap (5f, AW) in March; held in fourth in a classified event there last Monday but that was a creditable effort from a wide draw; now returns to turf but he's unexposed in this sphere and is a big player if he can run near his best.

runners_data.name: Ziva's Star
runners_data.note: Hold-up style 20-race maiden adding cheekpieces but poor recent form makes her hard to recommend
runners_data.comment: 0-19 but she hasn't been beaten far in two runs here this season; could go well
runners_data.spotlight: 20-race maiden who has finished down the field in her three runs (5f-7f) this season; cheekpieces are now added but this looks a tough assignment on the figures and others are preferred.

runners_data.name: Rohini
runners_data.note: Returns after 275-day absence under strong trainer but showed only poor form in previous 2yo efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Poor form in three 2yo runs over this trip for Robert Cowell; now drops into a classified event but she returns after nine months off and needs major improvement for new yard.

runners_data.name: Dottie Diamond
runners_data.note: Has fading tendency in finish and returns from 576-day break with consistently poor form figures
runners_data.spotlight: 4yo filly who has finished ahead of only five rivals in her five starts and latest was in a Chelmsford handicap (5f, AW) in November 2024; can only be watched back from 576 days off.

runners_data.name: Bridget's Baby
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who struggled in better company but drops to classified level with leading jockey booked
runners_data.spotlight: Struggled at massive prices in maiden/novice events and latest was on her reappearance here (7f, good to firm) last month; still early days and now drops into a classified contest but she needs a transformation back in trip.

runners_data.name: Tilsworth Ony Ta
runners_data.note: Veteran campaigner with fading tendency who hasn't won since July 2023 despite multiple attempts
runners_data.comment: His last success was in July 2024 and has form figures of 87909 this year; opposable
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner but his last success was in July 2024 and he has form figures of 879090 this year; opposable.

races.paceDynamic: Bridget's Baby will lead from the gates with several prominent racers including Antiphon, Dreambird Dolly and Dunnington Lad tracking close behind in the early stages. The confirmed front runner Bridget's Baby won't face serious pressure for the lead, creating a sustainable pace that should allow the field to stay in touch. A Lott Of Kane and Ziva's Star will need to overcome their hold-up styles on a short 5f trip. This pace setup clearly favours prominent racers and those with early speed, as hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground over this minimum distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Bridget's Baby sets a reasonable pace without burning out early
scenarios.body: The sustainable tempo allows prominent runners like Dreambird Dolly and Antiphon to track the leader and kick clear in the final furlong. Hold-up horses A Lott Of Kane and Ziva's Star find themselves with too much to do over the short trip.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Hangs On
scenarios.trigger: If Bridget's Baby gets an easy uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to build an advantage that proves decisive, with prominent runners unable to reel her back in time. Silvestre De Sousa's experience proves crucial in managing the filly's effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong with prominent runners pressing Bridget's Baby early
scenarios.body: A Lott Of Kane benefits from his 7lb weight allowance and fresh form, sweeping past tiring leaders in the final 100 yards. The faster tempo sets up perfectly for his finishing kick.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the market principals underperform and the race opens up dramatically
scenarios.body: Rohini shows significant improvement returning from her long break under Robert Cowell's guidance, taking advantage of her 7lb claim. The drop to classified company proves the key as she outpaces a weakened field.

watchPoints.text: Bridget's Baby could steal this if allowed an uncontested lead given the lack of other natural pace in the field
Watch for market support behind A Lott Of Kane as his hold-up style needs everything to fall right over 5f
Dreambird Dolly's headgear worked last time but she needs to reproduce that Brighton form to be competitive
Keep an eye on Rohini for any market confidence given Robert Cowell's strong recent form with his runners
Track conditions favor those with proven good to firm form, eliminating horses who need softer ground
